name: SalesNail 讲师
description: Design, generate, configure, publish, and teach SalesNail games with browser-based account authorization.
description_zh: 通过自然语言完成 SalesNail 游戏设计与生成、参数调整、教学材料生成、上架发布和创建课程。连接时在浏览器登录自己的 SalesNail 账号，无需填写 Token 或配置技术参数。
description_en: Design and generate SalesNail games, adjust parameters, create teaching materials, publish scenarios, and create courses with browser-based account authorization.
examples_zh: 为制造业大客户销售培训设计并生成一个中文游戏
把我最新游戏第二轮的行动点改为 10，先让我确认变更
为这个游戏生成讲师手册、学员任务书和课后复盘题
检查这个游戏能否上架，说明费用后等我确认
用刚上架的游戏创建一门 30 人、5 组的正式课
examples_en: Design and generate a Chinese enterprise-sales game for a manufacturing company
Change round two action points to 10 and show me the change before applying it
Generate a trainer guide, learner brief, and debrief questions for this game
Check whether this game can be published and wait for my confirmation after showing the fee
Create a formal 30-learner, five-group course from the published game
